title: Group-based validation protected reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong submission for Group-based validation should complete this objective: Evaluate data containing related observations. It should demonstrate the expected outcome (Prevent group leakage.), use a consistent and reproducible setup, report evidence rather than speculation, and address the limitation: Keep observations from the same group out of both training and validation folds.
explanation: Review the result for technical correctness and reproducibility. The automatic check only looks for GroupKFold, groups, cross_val_score and does not run the learner code. Keep observations from the same group out of both training and validation folds.
